strategy.observation: Apollo offers a database of people and companies to help users find and connect with ideal customers at scale.
strategy.offer_link: An enrichment quality audit could assess the accuracy and completeness of the people and company records in that database, helping Apollo understand where record quality may affect customers’ prospecting.
hypotheses: Apollo may be evaluating ways to identify gaps in the accuracy or completeness of its database.
The Head of Data may be responsible for data-quality processes that an external audit could support.
strategy.angle: Since Apollo’s database helps customers find and connect with prospects, I thought a targeted audit of its enrichment quality might be relevant to your data work.
strategy.fit_reason: The offer directly concerns the quality of sales-database data, and Apollo’s people-and-company database is a core part of its product; the facts do not establish whether Apollo currently needs an external audit.

draft.subject: Record quality at Apollo
draft.body: Since customers rely on Apollo’s people and company records to find prospects, gaps in accuracy or completeness could affect their prospecting. I do data-enrichment quality audits for sales databases to identify those gaps and show where record quality may be affecting prospecting. Would a small audit of one record segment help you assess where accuracy or coverage needs attention?
